summary: Learn data profiling, validation rules, stewardship, and operating-model design. Build practical artefacts for analytics and migration work. Explore the course.
lede: Data quality management for analytics and AI assesses whether business data is fit for its intended use. Designed for data governance leads, analysts, BI teams and ERP owners, this course helps you profile important fields, define validation rules and investigate data defects affecting reporting and AI readiness. Exercises cover quality dimensions, stewardship responsibilities and remediation planning, alongside an overview of AI-assisted anomaly detection.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people responsible for the reliability, governance, and practical use of business data across reporting and transformation work.
modules: Data Profiling with Excel and Power Query
prerequisites: Working familiarity with spreadsheets, business data, reporting, or data-related processes is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring no confidential or personally identifiable data to exercises.
